title: Chapter 1248
text:
In the past, there were people who asked me why I didn't update after midnight. This time, I'll make it clear. My after midnight refers to the time between midnight and 5 am. I don't know when I'll finish writing, so don't wait and go to bed early. Anyway, the chapters I've written won't grow legs and run away on their own. I can read them whenever I want. Writing is work, so why stay up late with me? If I don't have to work, I'll go to bed early every day. Isn't it better to dream?

"Godly Mechanic" will be updated later today.

Please wait for a moment. After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest update!
